_how_to_use: Projects shown on the profile, in this order. Add one here, or just add the topic 'showcase' to any public repo you own: the weekly workflow adds it at the end. Fields: repo (owner/name) or url; name; kind (small label); blurb (2-3 lines); status ('auto' shows the latest release, or any text like 'Live' or 'In development'). language, license and version are fallbacks used when GitHub can't be reached. Optional: mono (2-letter tile), link_label. exclude: repos never to show, even if tagged 'showcase'.
